headline: Anthropic Reaches $1.3 Trillion Valuation in Stock Market Debut
summary: AI startup Anthropic completed its stock market debut, reaching a peak valuation of $1.3 trillion on its first day of trading. Chief Executive Officer Dario Amodei stated the record IPO strengthened the company's resolve.
why: Anthropic is a major artificial intelligence research company and developer of the Claude AI chatbot assistant.

impacts.name: Anthropic
impacts.why: Anthropic achieved a peak valuation of $1.3 trillion during its initial public offering.
